_note: Mechanics only, written for this app: no rules text and no text from the campaign book. Card codes are MarvelCDB codes for pack 'aoa'; names are resolved from the card database at runtime so they appear in the player's language.

notice.fr:
Campagne non officielle, reconstituée pour l'application : le livret et les cartes de la boîte L'Ère d'Apocalypse restent nécessaires pour jouer.

L'application tire pour vous l'ordre des Quatre Cavaliers et le sbire HIÉRARQUE de chaque partie, retient les manigances annexes MISSION déjà jouées et les HIÉRARQUES vaincus, et tient le registre : points de victoire, sort du Professeur, et en campagne experte les points de vie de chaque identité entre les parties.
notice.en:
Unofficial, reconstructed for the app: the rulebook and cards from the Age of Apocalypse box are still needed to play.

The app draws the order of the four Horsemen and each game's OVERSEER for you, remembers which MISSIONS have been played and which OVERSEERS were defeated, and keeps the log: victory points, what became of the Professor, and in an expert campaign each hero's hit points between games.

text.fr:
La régénération conserve le stade, soigne Apocalypse et retire de la menace. Défaussez ses attachements.
No Longer Worthy permet de le vaincre (livret p. 14).

Regeneration keeps the current stage, heals Apocalypse and removes threat. Discard his attachments.
No Longer Worthy allows his defeat (booklet p. 14).

victoryEpilogue.fr: Le remède est récupéré et le Professeur est sauvé. Après ce détour à travers le temps, les X-Men retrouvent enfin leur foyer. Épilogue : livret p. 21.
victoryEpilogue.en: The cure is recovered and the Professor is saved. After their journey through time, the X-Men finally return home. Epilogue: booklet p. 21.

defeatEpilogue.fr: Apocalypse est tombé, mais le Professeur n’a pas pu être sauvé. Cette victoire sur le méchant ne suffit pas : la campagne est perdue. Livret p. 20.
defeatEpilogue.en: Apocalypse has fallen, but the Professor could not be saved. Defeating the villain is not enough: the campaign is lost. Booklet p. 20.
